statement: On a Juggler CycleMin start n ≥ 12 of leftover length L at o = o_min(L), a circuit from n with k odds and ℓ evens requires 3^k ≥ 2^{k+ℓ}. Hence n admits no OE-start and an OO-circuit from n takes only one even. The adversarial length-only packing is therefore o−e copies of OOE from n (one unique visit, the rest at n+2) and 2e−o copies of OE from the least odd v with v^3 ≥ n^4. Combined with internals at T(n) and evens at n^2 this yields a 6/5 ceiling strictly smaller than the parity sum whenever 2e−o > 0. The cycle maximum can be sent to infinity without changing the valley packing. Not Lean. Not a halt theorem.
